scope: Tracked bounded source/docs and approved manifest filenames were processed only inside a local Python process. Conventional credential, patient, database, fixture, backup and migration paths were excluded. No private excerpts, symbol names or document contents were emitted to model tools or copied into shared research.
privacy_limit: Filename exclusion is not a comprehensive embedded-secret or sensitive-content detector. The earlier no_credentials_data_or_databases_read flag means no designated credential/database/patient files intentionally accessed; it is not certification that every allowed source/document was free of embedded sensitive text.
